text:
ana: Quick sync: creating a tiny migrate note + FAQ for Optimize Toolkit about batching + caching with quant profiles. Need two snippets: Node.js streaming (minimal) and curl example for quick testing. Looking for a reviewer for anchors and a perf blurb.

phil: I can check the Node API shape. Keep it minimal and avoid streaming internals.

nate: I'll own the curl example and ensure it uses the stable /v1/generate endpoint and doesn't leak internal headers.

ana: Draft Node snippet (phil please verify):

```js
// pseudocode - redwood-js
import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const resp = await client.generate({ model: '<model-name>', max_tokens: 60, batching: { type: 'micro', max_batch_tokens: 256 }, kv_prefetch: false })
console.log(await resp.text())
```

phil: Looks good. Suggest `max_tokens` aligns casing with JS conventions `maxTokens` but that's fine if our SDK uses snake_case. I'll confirm.

nate: curl example for quick verification and CI smoke:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"<model-name>","max_tokens":48,"batching":{"type":"micro","max_batch_tokens":256},"kv_prefetch":false}'
```

ana: I'll add a one-liner that suggests toggling `kv_prefetch` when switching to quantized backends. Also will add cross-ref to /optimize/quantization.md#quantization-guidance.

docs-bot: Note: curl examples are fine but ensure we don't include internal-only models. Also add samplegen metadata if adding new snippets.

phil: I'll double-check the JS SDK param names; if we rename fields in the snippet we'll add a short footnote.

nate: Quick perf note: for our short prompt set, micro-batching at 256 tokens gave better throughput at high concurrency; for single-user latency the non-batched path is still better. I'll put that in one sentence in the FAQ.

ana: Plan: I'll open the PR and tag you both. Will include anchors and samplegen stub. Targeting small PR and merge after reviews. :white_check_mark:
